T1.implementation_approach: Organize the project into folders for frontend, backend, and shared resources; initialize version control and package managers.
T1.notes: Follow best practices for project structure to ensure scalability.

T2.implementation_approach: Design a responsive homepage using wireframes and implement it with HTML, CSS, and a frontend framework like React.
T2.notes: Ensure the design is user-friendly and mobile-compatible.

T3.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle CRUD operations for problems using a backend framework like Node.js or Django.
T3.notes: Focus on scalability and secure data handling.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a user interface to display, search, and filter problems using a frontend framework.
T4.notes: Ensure seamless integration with the problem repository backend.

T5.implementation_approach: Build APIs to handle code submissions, execute code in a sandboxed environment, and return results.
T5.notes: Prioritize security to prevent malicious code execution.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a UI for users to submit code and view results in real-time.
T6.notes: Incorporate clear feedback for errors and execution results.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to calculate and retrieve leaderboard rankings based on user performance.
T7.notes: Optimize for real-time updates and scalability.

T8.implementation_approach: Create a dynamic leaderboard UI to display rankings and user statistics.
T8.notes: Ensure the UI updates in real-time and is visually appealing.

T9.implementation_approach: Develop APIs to manage tutorials and hints, including retrieval and updates.
T9.notes: Allow for versioning and categorization of content.

T10.implementation_approach: Design a UI to display tutorials and hints in an organized and accessible manner.
T10.notes: Include search and filtering options for ease of use.

T11.implementation_approach: Build APIs to manage user profiles, including authentication, profile updates, and data retrieval.
T11.notes: Ensure secure handling of user data and implement role-based access control.

T12.implementation_approach: Create a user-friendly interface for users to view and edit their profiles.
T12.notes: Incorporate features like profile picture upload and activity tracking.

T13.implementation_approach: Design a normalized database schema to support all platform features and implement it using a relational database like PostgreSQL.
T13.notes: Ensure proper indexing and relationships for efficient queries.

T14.implementation_approach: Integrate backend APIs with the database using an ORM or raw queries.
T14.notes: Test database connections and query performance thoroughly.

T15.implementation_approach: Write unit tests for each backend API endpoint using a testing framework like Jest or Pytest.
T15.notes: Aim for high test coverage and include edge cases.

T16.implementation_approach: Develop integration tests to validate the interaction between different components of the system.
T16.notes: Simulate real-world scenarios to ensure end-to-end functionality.

T17.implementation_approach: Set up CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions or Jenkins to automate testing and deployment.
T17.notes: Include steps for linting, testing, and deployment to staging and production environments.

T18.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform to a cloud provider like AWS, Azure, or GCP, and configure DNS and SSL.
T18.notes: Monitor the deployment for performance and security issues.
